Opposite Party  Mr. K.K. Gaya, ASC  CORAM: JUSTICE V. NARASINGH  ORDER 10.11.2023 Order No.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with Special (POCSO) Case No.21 of 2022, pending on the file of learned Fast Track Court cum Additional District Judge, Angul, arising out of Angul P.S.
Case No.133 of 2022 for the alleged commission of offence under Section 506/376-AB/376(2)(n)
IPC and Section 6(i) of the POCSO Act.

entities.text: Fast Track Court cum Additional District Judge, Angul
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of their application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Additional District Judge, FTSC, Angul by order dated 26.09.2023, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. Notice is stated to have been served on the informant/victim on 10.10.2023 indicating that the matter shall be taken up today (10.11.2023).
There is no appearance on behalf of the informant/victim when the matter is called.
5. It is stated by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 08.03.2022 and as the victim has already been examined, his further continuance in custody is unwarranted.
6. It is the further submission of the learned counsel for the Petitioner that the victim has given prevaricating statement and the medical examination does not lend credence to the accusation.

sentences.text: This Court is not persuaded to agree with the submission of the learned counsel for the Petitioner.

8. As rightly observed by the learned Court in seisin, at this stage, it would not be prudent to make any observation regarding the nature of evidence adduced, since it will prejudice the ongoing trial.

9. Taking into account the nature of accusation, the evidence of the victim-P.W.2 aged about 7 years,
this Court is not inclined to entertain the bail application of the Petitioner at this stage.
10. Learned Court in seisin is requested to conclude the trial expeditiously.
11. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
12. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
(V. NARASINGH)
